title: Competency Assessment (rec → competencies mapping)
description: Maps a source-canonical recommendation to the atomic Evideris-derived competencies it implies. Replaces the `assessesCompetencies[]` field that used to live on `recommendation` in the v0 schema (moved out so source-canonical recs stay verbatim ESGE content).

subItem.description: Optional roman-numeral sub-item label if this competency maps to a specific sub-item of the rec

weight.description: Optional weight if the competency is partially assessed by this rec
